name: Read-time-honest sentiment velocity — xAI twitter sentiment cross with breadth guard (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: twitter_sentiment is captured at xAI FETCH time, so observation == availability — a read-time-honest social feature usable at 1h without look-ahead (unlike daily T+1 sources). A rapid bullish swing in the X narrative precedes the short-horizon move as fresh takes hit before order flow; the counterparty is discretionary traders still scrolling. Trade a twitter_sentiment cross above a fitted bull floor, gated by author breadth (contributors_active) to screen bot/wash spikes. DISCONFIRMER: confirm the store's xAI fetch cadence actually supports 1h bars — if fetched only a few times a day the 1h signal is stale-repeated, KILL. A sentiment spike with no author breadth is likely manufactured (bot/wash) — the breadth gate is the tripwire. Must clear net fees at 1h turnover.
catalyst: a fresh bullish xAI/X sentiment swing backed by real author breadth
